statements.impact_statement: The advisory covers golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp, which no imago build contains: osv matches the whole module, while go list -deps -test ./... names only golang.org/x/crypto/sha3 from golang.org/x/crypto, required through golusoris core validate and go-playground/validator. govulncheck in symbol mode reports the module as required but not called.
